description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core MVC controller named ProfilesController within the Profiles feature of the Conduit project. It handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve profile details based on username using MediatR for request handling.

classes.name: ProfilesController
classes.description: A controller responsible for handling profile-related HTTP requests. Uses constructor injection of IMediator to dispatch queries.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve profile information based on username, utilizing MediatR to send a query and asynchronously returning the profile envelope.
